# Saudex Global

> Saudex Global is a Singapore-registered logistics, import/export and freight forwarding company serving businesses across Asia and the Middle East, with a focus on the Singapore–GCC–APAC trade corridor. It combines global trading, supplier sourcing, freight forwarding (sea, air and land), customs clearance and cross-border logistics so customers can move goods from source to destination through one provider.

Saudex Global has a presence in Singapore, Malaysia, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates. Customers typically request a quote, confirm the shipment, and Saudex handles pickup, freight forwarding, customs clearance and final delivery with status updates along the way.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://saudexglobal.com/services/service/): All logistics and trading services offered by Saudex Global
- [Import & Export](https://saudexglobal.com/services/impo-expo/): Import/export support, product sourcing and supplier coordination
- [Freight Forwarding](https://saudexglobal.com/services/freight/): Sea, air and land freight, warehousing and cross-border logistics
- [FMCG Distribution](https://saudexglobal.com/services/fmcg/): Distribution of fast-moving consumer goods across the region
- [Customs Clearance & Compliance](https://saudexglobal.com/services/customs/): Customs documentation, clearance and regulatory compliance

## Industries

- [Food & Beverage](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/food_beverages/): Logistics for food and beverage products, including temperature-sensitive cargo
- [HoReCa](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/horeca/): Supply and logistics for hotels, restaurants and catering
- [Agri-Commodities & Palm Oil](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/agriculture/): Trade and shipping of agricultural commodities and palm oil
- [FMCG](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/fmcg_industry/): Logistics for consumer goods brands and distributors
- [Retail & Wholesale](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/retail/): Supply chain support for retailers and wholesalers
- [E-Commerce](https://saudexglobal.com/industries/e_commerce/): Cross-border fulfilment and shipping for online sellers
